title: Stitching Science: How Knitting Insects Sparks Curiosity and Conversation
content: Knitting and entomology might seem like an unlikely pairing, but as entomologists who knit, we have discovered that this combination powerfully engages the public in conversations about insects. Our insect-inspired knitting projects serve as an effective form of science communication. By wearing our creations, sharing our knits on social media, and hosting knitting events, we have blended fiber art with science. This unique fusion captivates diverse audiences, fostering a deeper appreciation for insects.
